events.text: The underlying defect is now clear: the SDAT loader’s “remove phase cycle” operation runs on a newly allocated all-zero array and is then overwritten when subspectra are populated, so it never corrects the acquired FIDs. I’m implementing that operation after subspectrum construction, with a safe zero-first-point fallback and an explicit opt-out so polarity-preserving workflows do not get silently normalized.
